# Decision Making Framework

## When to use
Use when the task requires make evidence-based, risk-adjusted decisions and resolve contradictory subagent recommendations.

## Procedure
Compare alternatives using expected net value, payout feasibility, risks, proof quality, reversibility, and user preferences. Treat compliance and payout as hard gates. Decide PROCEED_TO_PLAN, REQUEST_APPROVAL, HOLD, REWORK, MONITOR or REJECT with rationale and review trigger; never spend without user authorization.

## Mandatory handoff
Return: input/assumptions, steps completed, dated evidence or local record IDs, confidence, blockers, quality checks, next action. If required evidence or permission is missing, stop and mark UNVERIFIED or BLOCKED rather than guessing.

## Safety
No financial commitment, account registration, external outreach, false identity, geographic restriction bypass, or publication without explicit user approval. Avoid leaking credentials or private data.
